name: World Vision
story: $1,000 reaches **{international: 1000 * share * (people_reached + health_children + wash_people + livelihood_members * household_size + education_children + gik_people) / cost_total} people** abroad with health care, clean water, livelihoods, schooling and goods, and every **{domestic: cost_total / households_reached|$}** reaches one US family with donated goods.
summary: A Christian humanitarian organisation: World Vision US raises money, mostly child sponsorships, US government grants and WFP food, for World Vision's community development (health and nutrition, clean water, education, livelihoods) and disaster and food-crisis response in nearly 100 countries, chiefly in Sub-Saharan Africa. It also passes donated goods to US churches, schools and nonprofits and advocates on global poverty.
